trackDescription: Focuses on Slalom’s business by delivering capabilities and offerings to customers, and supports business growth through excellent delivery. Leaders in this track are accountable for ensuring the successful delivery of team projects and cultivating talent within their teams.
jobTitleSummary: Encourages teams to meet delivery commitments by proactively removing obstacles and building authentic relationships. Demonstrates advanced functional/technical expertise through mentorship and innovative solutioning that addresses complex problems.

Deliver Exceptionally.expectation: Guides teams and clients to meet and exceed delivery commitments.
Independently manages competing priorities, making informed trade-offs to optimize outcomes for clients and teams.
Identifies issues and problem solves to maintain velocity.
Proactively removes obstacles for self, manages escalations appropriately, and co-creates solutions with leadership.
Applies Slalom and industry best practices to quality work products.
Offers solution input and influences work quality and accuracy.
Synthesizes complex information from multiple sources to develop well-rounded insights and employs advanced problem-solving techniques to address challenges.
Effectively leverages emerging technologies (e.g., AI, AI agents) to enhance productivity and delivery outcomes.
Considers and develops new, better, or unique methods, bringing creative solutions to meet client needs.
Designs and monitors success measures (qualitative and quantitative).
Delivers high-quality written and visual communications.
Communicates effectively across varying perspectives, organizing thoughts and articulating alternatives/tradeoffs.
Communicates productively and candidly, showing sensitivity to being inclusive in communications.
Onboards efficiently to new projects, immediately contributes to delivery and project success, and supports effective onboarding for team members.
Embraces various cultures within the client organization by being flexible and adjusting to varying client settings.
Builds trust with clients by helping them understand Slalom processes and approach.
Seeks and applies information about underlying client needs.
Skillfully resolves client issues promptly and responds non-defensively, escalating when appropriate.
Discusses how project outcomes align with the client’s broader strategic goals.
Highlights tangible results (e.g., cost savings, efficiency improvements) in team or client updates.
Confidently speaks about the project’s outcomes and the logic behind them and relevant client stories or use cases.
Proactively seeks opportunities to showcase the successes of colleagues and the project team.
Applies active listening and thoughtful communication techniques to influence discussions based on audience needs as well as encourage clear decision-making with teams and clients.

Grow Expertise.expectation: Deepens and/or broadens in Functional/Technical roles (e.g., Advanced+ in 1+).
May explore and develop in Engagement roles (e.g., Delivery Solution Lead, Engagement Lead) and Pursuit roles (e.g., Sales Solution Lead, Pursuit Lead).
May be a People Leader (e.g., w/ mastery and business need).
Is recognized in area of expertise and shares knowledge with team members and clients.
Seeks opportunities to upskill and stretch beyond comfort zone, optimizing for own learning style.
Coaches or mentors others by asking thoughtful questions to encourage critical thinking and a growth mindset.
May lend expertise to enhance Slalom solutions (e.g., perspectives, offerings, accelerators) for a capability, industry, or customer outcome, if prioritized.
May lend expertise to develop or deliver learning opportunities for the capability, industry, solution, customer outcome, if prioritized.
Demonstrates curiosity about emerging technologies (e.g., AI, AI agents) by actively seeking guidance from mentors and available resources.
Captures and leverages Slalom thought leadership, stories, and assets to support knowledge management.
Builds and actively leverages expertise on client's business and industry to enhance delivery and partnership with clients.

Grow Slalom.expectation: Maintains client relationships and proactively connects with external experts and networks in areas of interest or expertise.
Is a steward of the Slalom brand (e.g., culture, core values, strategic initiatives, solutions, impact, the value Slalom offers to clients), actively promoting it outside the organization.
Deepens and broadens connections across Slalom, on projects and across capability, geography, outcome andindustry teams.
Shapes Slalom culture by demonstrating core values and actively engaging in Slalom events and initiatives (e.g., employee resource groups, hackathons).
Has a basic understanding of Slalom-wide financial metrics and foundational business operational knowledge.

Proactively maximizes staffability by regularly updating profile, initiating staffing conversations, and engaging in meaningful bench activity (e.g., skill development, solutioning, Learning and Development, pursuits).
Enters time and expenses accurately and on time; plans and seeks approval for time off.
May support team's people processes (e.g., onboarding, staffing, and performance management).
Continues to identify opportunities in delivery environments, sharing with project / account leads.
Seeks exposure to sales process, proposals, and statements of work (SOW) that set delivery expectations.
Effectively communicates Slalom’s value by delivering a clear elevator pitch and sharing relevant client stories from their capability area.

Demonstrates deeper understanding of Slalom business (e.g., capabilities, clients, industries, solutions) and strategy (e.g., how Slalom goes to market, value proposition, strategic priorities and initiatives).

Lead.expectation: Balances multiple priorities, proactively solves problems and maintains accountability under pressure.
Identifies and acts on growth opportunities identified via development and career goals, self-reflection, feedback, and performance processes.
Displays comfort with sharing mistakes and weaknesses.
Leverages awareness of own and others' emotions to navigate differences successfully, and tailors style to collaborate with others.
Manages and de-escalates conflicts independently, fostering collaboration and coaching others.
Uses the Situation-Behavior-Impact (SBI) framework to structure their feedback and give timely, specific feedback, both positive and constructive.
Helps peers and teams interpret and stay open to change and new ways of working.
Communicates openly with teams or stakeholders when navigating change.
Understands team member career aspirations, interests, skills, and skill gaps.
Actively connects team members to appropriate development experiences and others they can learn from.
Ensures directs understand performance expectations, and guides them to understand and action on strengths and opportunities uncovered in performance processes via ongoing feedback and coaching.
Proactively identifies early signs of performance gaps and collaborates with leaders and HR to support course correction.

Assesses directs' performance against defined expectations and outcomes, actively participating in calibration discussions to ensure fair and objective evaluation and differentiation of top performers.
Ensures work contributes to internal team vision and strategy, while flagging risks and opportunities.

Empowers directs to identify and pursue their career aspirations at Slalom by sharing perspective on potential career directions and providing support and resources to enable their career development.
Capable of navigating high levels of ambiguity with appropriate oversight and direction, and moderate functioning independently under low levels of ambiguity.
Collaborates where appropriate to deliver outcomes more effectively and efficiently.
Regularly gives and seeks feedback in a holistic, 360' fashion - and actions on it.
Receives feedback with an open mind, curiosity, and respect, and follows up as needed to ensure the feedback is actionable.
